_meta.description: Community-submitted local HumanEval+ runs. Append one entry per run to `entries`. PRs touching only this file are auto-validated by CI. When a model accumulates >= PROMOTION_THRESHOLD entries from distinct users, maintainers aggregate them into the `local` field in index.html (see scripts/promote_user_benchmarks.py).

schema.model: model name EXACTLY as it appears in index.html (models.json 'name')
schema.hf_id: Hugging Face repo id you ran
schema.precision: dtype used, e.g. bf16, q4_K_M (gguf), gptq-4bit

rules: one entry per run; re-runs by the same user replace their earlier entry for that model
humaneval_plus must be from the official EvalPlus evaluator (or equivalent harness counting base+extra tests)
greedy (temp 0) runs strongly preferred; note if sampled

entries.notes: plain chatml prompt, greedy; official EvalPlus evaluator
